page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with a numerical display in the upper part, centred heading below it. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. A faint print from the facing page shows through in the middle and right; it is not transcribed. The left strip is the edge of the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.; One printed page, main text block in the centre with handwritten-style multiplication/division workings (printed as cast-off figures) above and below; a faint page of print show-through in the background at upper right (not transcribed); a narrow block of text in the left margin (partly visible, cut off at the left edge) is a note column.

main_text.p: ter 14 ↄ 6, 30 ↄ 18, 49 ↄ 14, ut hic uides:
main_text.head: COMPENDIVM.
main_text.p: ¶ Cùm diuisio nihil sit aliud quàm multiplex Subdu-ctio, si maiorē minore diuiseris, idē expeditiore uia absol-ues. In huiusmodi tamē diuisionibus Quoti nulla habē-da ratio, sed Diuisor tantùm cum Residuo conferendus, Vt 234 ↄ 17 inter se primos esse diuisio prodit, sic:
main_text.head: CAPVT

page.notes: The numerical display is a division scheme in which the rules and brackets are drawn lines; they are rendered as dashes and bracketed numbers in the rows. The alignment of the rows in the right and left columns is approximate. The faint text on the right and in the centre belongs to the facing page showing through and is not transcribed. The page continues in the second part of the scan. The left margin holds fragments of a note column (e.g. "bost as", "miatur", "um ab", "Vt in", "ter 14") which are cut off at the left edge of this image; they are only partly legible and are not transcribed. The upper area shows faint show-through of the reverse page and is ignored. The cast-off figures are printed workings, rendered here as plain lines; their exact arrangement is approximate.
